newsitem.title: USA: Westchester, NY County Exec won't seek re-election.
newsitem.headline: Westchester, NY County Exec won't seek re-election.

text.p: Westchester County, N.Y., County Executive Andrew O'Rourke, who has served in this office since 1983, said on Monday that he would not seek re-election but will serve out the rest of his term.
"And I will take some time over the next few months to examine the many options open to me and to choose the right one," he said in prepared remarks.
O'Rourke was elected to County Executive in 1983 to serve ou the balance of Alfred DelBello's term. DelBello left the office to become Lieutenant Governor.
